model: GA_Hathor_Melee public primary packet is GE_Player_Hathor_Melee1_Damage. Native coefficients at Normal levels 1/8/9 are 0.243/0.416/0.450; category A/LAKSHANA metadata stays source-bound.

An explicit GA_Hathor_Melee command may select GE_Player_Hathor_Branch_Damage or GE_Player_Hathor_AirAttack_Damage as one direct packet using the Normal talent coordinate and caller impact time. Branch rates at levels 1/8/9 are 2.400/4.113/4.442, category A, ChargeAdd 12.0; AirAttack rates are 1.250/2.142/2.314, category X, ChargeAdd 6.3. The direct input leaves the ordinary Normal chain unchanged and is excluded from ordinary-hit energy. Positive target-zero HP loss can grant its exact ChargeAdd under separate hypothesis hathor.branch_airattack_direct_packet_energy_v1; this does not establish native eligibility. With an explicit break_profile, the separate shared UnbalValue-to-gauge hypothesis may subtract the packet value; this does not establish Hathor-specific Break rules. This API input does not model natural dispatch, legality, costs, movement, extra hits, target rules or timing; Branch tips bind its GE with Name=None, while AirAttack is named in its tips row.

GA_Hathor_Skill public primary packet is GE_Player_Hathor_Skill1_Damage, delivering a 3-hit packet train (two GE_Player_Hathor_Skill1_Damage plus one GE_Player_Hathor_Skill11_Damage). Native coefficients at Skill levels 1/8/9 are 1.000/1.714/1.851 per hit; category E/LAKSHANA metadata stays source-bound. on_cast activates Emergency Delivery for 5s (Buff_HathorAngerActive_AtkUp: +15% ATK) and grants Express Delivery Power stacks (A1). At A4, grants +25% Crit Rate on Skill during Emergency Delivery.

GA_Hathor_UltraSkill public primary packet is GE_Player_Hathor_UltraSkill1_Damage, delivering a 3-hit packet train (two GE_Player_Hathor_UltraSkill1_Damage plus one GE_Player_Hathor_UltraSkill2_Damage). Native coefficients at Burst levels 1/8/9 are 0.962/1.649/1.781 for UltraSkill1 and 5.076/8.699/9.395 for UltraSkill2; category Q/LAKSHANA metadata stays source-bound. on_cast activates Emergency Delivery for 5s (+15% ATK) and grants 5 stacks of Express Delivery Power.
Resonance 3 activates at awakening >= 3 and adds +1 level to Melee, Skill, and UltraSkill without manual overrides.

Awakening passive effects modeled: A1 first hold/cast grants 6 stacks of Express Delivery Power, A3 grants +15% damage bonus to non-boss targets, A4 grants +25% Crit Rate on Skill during Emergency Delivery, A5 grants +1% damage per Express Delivery Power stack up to 15%, A6 grants +30% Crit DMG during Emergency Delivery, resonance_6 grants 10% DEF ignore during Emergency Delivery.
